entries.title: Footer Git metadata, asynchronous refresh and extension status data
entries.source: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/footer-data-provider.ts:1-454`; `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/utils/fs-watch.ts:1-31`; `ice:packages/coding-agent/test/footer-data-provider.test.ts:1-322`.
entries.what: Supplies branch/worktree metadata, throttled ahead/behind/dirty counts and extension status values to footer consumers, with watcher retries and explicit disposal.
entries.mechanism:
FooterDataProvider discovers Git metadata from its cwd and caches branch/status values separately. Branch changes are watched and debounced, while working-tree counts refresh only when requested by a footer consumer.

findGitPaths walks upward for .git. A directory uses .git/HEAD; a file beginning exactly 'gitdir: ' resolves its remainder relative to that directory, then resolves an optional commondir relative to the Git directory. Missing HEAD or a filesystem exception returns null immediately. An unrecognized .git file allows the walk to continue. The returned repoDir is the worktree/root used for Git subprocesses, commonGitDir locates shared reftable files, and headPath locates this worktree's HEAD. A regular 'ref: refs/heads/' HEAD preserves the full branch suffix. '.invalid' asks git --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD, synchronously on first getGitBranch and asynchronously during refresh; failure maps to 'detached'. Other readable HEAD contents also map to 'detached'; missing/read errors map to null. The symbolic-ref subprocess helpers do not set a timeout here (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/footer-data-provider.ts:16-81`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/footer-data-provider.ts:303-331`).

The branch watcher watches HEAD's parent directory to survive atomic replacement and reacts to missing filenames or exactly HEAD. On Linux with WSL_DISTRO_NAME/WSL_INTEROP and a /mnt/<drive> repo it additionally watchFiles HEAD every1000ms, comparing mtime/ctime/size. If a shared reftable directory exists, it watches that directory and, when tables.list exists, watches that file plus250ms metadata polling. Events schedule one500ms refresh; an event during an in-flight refresh marks a pending rerun. Callback notification occurs only when a previously known cached branch changes. Initial refresh can fill an undefined cache without notification. Watch errors close all watchers and schedule a5000ms retry; watch construction errors use the same error callback. Cleanup cancels normal/retry timers and unregisters polling. Filesystem close errors are ignored (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/footer-data-provider.ts:265-445`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/utils/fs-watch.ts:1-31`).

getGitStatus returns the last cached result while starting a background git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain=v2 --branch, at most once per2000ms and only one in flight. It uses timeout2000ms and maxBuffer8MiB. Parser defaults ahead/behind/dirty to0, recognizes '# branch.ab +N -N', and counts lines beginning1/2/u/? plus a space; ignored paths do not count. Failure retains prior counts. Successful results are discarded after disposal or when repoDir differs from the captured request; a changed JSON result notifies the same branch listeners. There is no timer polling working-tree status in the background without calls (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/footer-data-provider.ts:83-118`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/footer-data-provider.ts:164-194`).

setCwd is a no-op for the same string; otherwise it cancels debounce/watchers, clears branch/status caches and status timestamp, rediscovers metadata, reinstalls watches and notifies listeners. It does not cancel subprocesses or attach a generation guard to the asynchronous '.invalid' branch resolution, so an old branch request can settle after a cwd change and overwrite the new cache. That is a source limitation; status requests have the repoDir check described above. dispose prevents asynchronous cache updates, closes watchers/timers and clears listeners. Listener callbacks are invoked synchronously without per-listener exception isolation.

Extension statuses are a live Map keyed by string; undefined deletes, an empty string remains, clear removes all. Setters do not notify listeners themselves; the UI setExtensionStatus caller requests a render. Available provider count is a stored number with no validation. ReadonlyFooterDataProvider exposes getGitBranch/getExtensionStatuses/getAvailableProviderCount/onBranchChange plus optional getGitStatus, excluding mutations/dispose. Tests cover regular nested repos, '.invalid' plain/worktree reftable lookup, detached fallback, debounce, unchanged-branch silence, retry after async watcher error and preserving counts on status failure; they were read only.

entries.dependency_text: EXT owns the public extension footer-data and setStatus bridge. SET owns general resource watcher use; this entry owns footer-specific Git discovery and refresh.
entries.rust: Native footer has a git_branch field and a working primary CLI startup watcher. find_git_head_path/git_branch_for walk parents for a literal .git/HEAD and watch that path through the native fs watcher; they do not resolve .git files/commondir/reftable. git_branch_for takes only the final slash-separated ref segment and uses the first7 characters of any other nonempty HEAD. Thus feature/name becomes name and reftable '.invalid' is displayed literally. Native scoped behavior search found no porcelain-v2 status provider or ahead/behind/dirty consumer; the native footer's complete body confirms those fields are absent (`rust:crates/ice-cli/src/interactive_tui/sessions.rs:628-667`, `rust:crates/ice-cli/src/interactive_tui.rs:1119-1134`, `rust:crates/ice-cli/src/fs_watch.rs:1-162`, `rust:crates/ice-tui/src/footer.rs:91-127`). Native extension status is synchronized through a separate registry revision into the footer and excludes pet/voice presentation where appropriate, so extension statuses are already implemented at host level (`rust:crates/ice-cli/src/interactive_tui/state.rs:1032-1053`).
entries.port: Retain native watcher lifecycle and extension registry synchronization, then add worktree/common-dir discovery, full branch names, reftable fallback and an on-demand status cache with bounded subprocess execution. Guard all asynchronous resolutions with a cwd generation and keep failed status refreshes from erasing useful counts.
entries.priority_reason: Current native branch display is wrong for common slash names and worktree/reftable repositories, and working-tree counts are absent.

entries.source: Complete appearance model and typed theme-setting adapter: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-types.ts:21-388`; defaults: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-defaults.ts:8-208`; migration: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-migrate.ts:16-117`; validator: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:15-1060`. Tests: `ice:packages/coding-agent/test/appearance-validate.test.ts:6-124`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/test/appearance-acceptance.test.ts:200-220`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/test/appearance-acceptance.test.ts:310-378`.
entries.what: Stores user-selected layout, decoration, text styling and animation separately from the color palette, and loads older appearance preferences with deterministic defaults.
entries.mechanism:
Validation produces a complete v2 appearance object together with path-specific issues. Missing sections receive defaults, malformed scalar values often normalize silently, and explicit format, color, enum or structural errors make valid=false while still returning a normalized object.

validateAppearance(undefined) succeeds with defaults; a non-record or version other than 1/2 fails and returns defaults. Version 1 migrates then validates. Migration overlays legacy userMessage/inputBox and thinking label/block, copies the legacy thinking indicator into both thinking.indicator and statusIndicators.working, preserves tableStyle, and adds caseSensitive:true to well-shaped legacy literal rules; malformed entries remain available for diagnostics. New v2 sections retain stock defaults (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-migrate.ts:16-71`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:419-463`).

General normalization uses floor and clamp for finite numeric values, fallback for other types; styles filter to allowed names and deduplicate in original order without issues; booleans accept only actual booleans. PaddingX is 0..8 and paddingY 0..4. Indicator interval is 16..5000 ms; at most the first 128 supplied frames are considered, each nonempty and <=64 UTF-8 bytes; invalid entries are skipped and an empty result is an issue. Thinking verbs consider the first 256 entries, trim/deduplicate, require nonempty strings <=128 UTF-8 bytes; empty result is an issue. The two format fields allow <=512 UTF-8 bytes and exactly one {message}/{verb}; other placeholders matching {letter[letters,digits,_,-]*} fail. These format/frame/verb checks do not reject all control characters. Hidden thinking label permits empty and <=128 UTF-8 bytes, otherwise silently defaults. Invalid selection values silently become cycle (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:46-158`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:237-337`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:465-620`).

Color objects distinguish theme/custom/terminal-index/terminal-default/none. Theme token length is 1..128 JS code units and must belong to the foreground or background token set for its role. Custom values <=128 code units must be #RGB/#RRGGBB, rgb(integer 0..255,...) or hsl(hue 0..360,saturation/lightness 0..100%). Eight-digit alpha hex is rejected. Terminal index must be an integer 0..255. None is accepted for explicitly transparent background fields, not foreground/border roles or most TextPresentation backgrounds. Unknown kinds/tokens return the field default plus an issue (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:163-235`).

Footer order filters known IDs, removes duplicates, then appends omitted default IDs; visibility is normalized independently. Separator allows <=32 UTF-8 bytes and rejects C0/DEL. Heading override h1..h6 is normalized only for truthy supplied values, using the default heading base rather than the supplied shared base. Every object section is read through isRecord fallback; the main validator does not diagnose every malformed section shape. Literal rule validation examines the first 65 items, records an issue if supplied length>64, defaults missing IDs to rule-<index>, consumes IDs before matcher validation, requires literal pattern length1..128 code units, truncates display name to64, defaults enabled/caseSensitive unless exactly false, clamps priority0..1000 with original index fallback. A failed validation may therefore return 65 normalized rules, but callers must honor valid=false (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:106-135`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:352-417`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:638-693`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:892-1044`).

The exact nested field types are declared in appearance-types.ts:52-287. TextPresentation={foreground:AppearanceColor,background:AppearanceColor,styles:AppearanceTextStyle[]}. Styles: bold|italic|underline|strikethrough|inverse. Border styles: none|single|double|round|bold|single-double|double-single|classic|top-bottom-single|top-bottom-double|top-bottom-bold; input border supports only first five. Table style: unicode|ascii|clean|clean-top-bottom|raw. Footer IDs: cwd,branch,session,usage,cache,cost,context,provider,model,thinking,extensions. Theme setting (verbatim): `{ mode: "fixed"; theme: string } | { mode: "automatic"; light: string; dark: string }`; parser accepts a nonempty fixed raw string without trimming, or exactly one slash with trimmed nonempty members; serializer returns theme or light/dark. Validation result: {valid:boolean,appearance:AppearanceSettingsV2,issues:{path:string,message:string}[]}.

Exact defaults are in appearance-defaults.ts:45-208: user {message}, no styles/border, semantic user colors, padding1/0, fit=false; assistant padding0/0/default background/no border; input single border with border token both states,pad0. Thinking frames ⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏,80ms,no reverse,accent; verbs Thinking/Reasoning/Considering/Working/Analyzing/Planning,cycle,{verb}...; visible thinking,Thinking... hidden label,italic/thinkingText. Status spinner colors accent/warning/muted/muted. Markdown unicode and no-override text, no borders/padding; code/quote border semantic tokens. Tools padding1/1,bold toolTitle,toolOutput,state backgrounds. Bash top-bottom-single,bashMode,pad1,bold command/muted output+status. Diff semantic added/removed/context. System cards no border,borderMuted,customMessageBg,padding1/1,custom label/text. Footer all fields visible in declared order,separator ' • ',dim primary/secondary; chrome no border,theme text/selectedBg,muted description,dim hint,default track/scrollbarThumb; subagent states accent/muted/error/warning/dim. No input highlighters by default.

entries.rust: No appearance document, migration, profile or customizer implementation was found by a crates-wide case-insensitive Rust search for appearance/customize/theme_profile/theme_bundle. Independently read native Theme has palette, spacing and border fields but no versioned per-domain appearance model (`rust:crates/ice-tui/src/theme.rs:15-171`, `rust:crates/ice-tui/src/theme.rs:264-386`). Native user rendering exposes one output_pad and a surface background (`rust:crates/ice-tui/src/user_message.rs:41-75`); native assistant options contain hide_thinking, hidden_thinking_label and output_pad (`rust:crates/ice-tui/src/assistant_message.rs:41-59`). These existing capabilities are a starting point, not the stored v2 contract.
entries.port: Add a serde-backed appearance module to ice-tui and global storage adapters to ice-cli through SET-017. Preserve separate palette and layout state. Implement migration and a normalized-value-plus-issues result, with explicit decisions about silently corrected inputs and character/byte bounds. Port defaults as data and apply them through component-specific adapters; keep validation independent of terminal execution.
entries.priority_reason: Required for migrating existing custom layouts and for all appearance editing and rendering features.

entries.what: Stores user-selected layout, decoration, text styling and animation separately from the color palette, and loads older appearance preferences with deterministic defaults.
entries.mechanism:
Validation produces a complete v2 appearance object together with path-specific issues. Missing sections receive defaults, malformed scalar values often normalize silently, and explicit format, color, enum or structural errors make valid=false while still returning a normalized object.

validateAppearance(undefined) succeeds with defaults; a non-record or version other than 1/2 fails and returns defaults. Version 1 migrates then validates. Migration overlays legacy userMessage/inputBox and thinking label/block, copies the legacy thinking indicator into both thinking.indicator and statusIndicators.working, preserves tableStyle, and adds caseSensitive:true to well-shaped legacy literal rules; malformed entries remain available for diagnostics. New v2 sections retain stock defaults (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-migrate.ts:16-71`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:419-463`).

General normalization uses floor and clamp for finite numeric values, fallback for other types; styles filter to allowed names and deduplicate in original order without issues; booleans accept only actual booleans. PaddingX is 0..8 and paddingY 0..4. Indicator interval is 16..5000 ms; at most the first 128 supplied frames are considered, each nonempty and <=64 UTF-8 bytes; invalid entries are skipped and an empty result is an issue. Thinking verbs consider the first 256 entries, trim/deduplicate, require nonempty strings <=128 UTF-8 bytes; empty result is an issue. The two format fields allow <=512 UTF-8 bytes and exactly one {message}/{verb}; other placeholders matching {letter[letters,digits,_,-]*} fail. These format/frame/verb checks do not reject all control characters. Hidden thinking label permits empty and <=128 UTF-8 bytes, otherwise silently defaults. Invalid selection values silently become cycle (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:46-158`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:237-337`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:465-620`).

Color objects distinguish theme/custom/terminal-index/terminal-default/none. Theme token length is 1..128 JS code units and must belong to the foreground or background token set for its role. Custom values <=128 code units must be #RGB/#RRGGBB, rgb(integer 0..255,...) or hsl(hue 0..360,saturation/lightness 0..100%). Eight-digit alpha hex is rejected. Terminal index must be an integer 0..255. None is accepted for explicitly transparent background fields, not foreground/border roles or most TextPresentation backgrounds. Unknown kinds/tokens return the field default plus an issue (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:163-235`).

Footer order filters known IDs, removes duplicates, then appends omitted default IDs; visibility is normalized independently. Separator allows <=32 UTF-8 bytes and rejects C0/DEL. Heading override h1..h6 is normalized only for truthy supplied values, using the default heading base rather than the supplied shared base. Every object section is read through isRecord fallback; the main validator does not diagnose every malformed section shape. Literal rule validation examines the first 65 items, records an issue if supplied length>64, defaults missing IDs to rule-<index>, consumes IDs before matcher validation, requires literal pattern length1..128 code units, truncates display name to64, defaults enabled/caseSensitive unless exactly false, clamps priority0..1000 with original index fallback. A failed validation may therefore return 65 normalized rules, but callers must honor valid=false (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:106-135`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:352-417`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:638-693`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:892-1044`).

The exact nested field types are declared in appearance-types.ts:52-287. TextPresentation={foreground:AppearanceColor,background:AppearanceColor,styles:AppearanceTextStyle[]}. Styles: bold|italic|underline|strikethrough|inverse. Border styles: none|single|double|round|bold|single-double|double-single|classic|top-bottom-single|top-bottom-double|top-bottom-bold; input border supports only first five. Tools padding1/1,bold toolTitle,toolOutput,state backgrounds. Bash top-bottom-single,bashMode,pad1,bold command/muted output+status. Diff semantic added/removed/context. entries.port: Add a serde-backed appearance module to ice-tui and global storage adapters to ice-cli through SET-017. Preserve separate palette and layout state. Implement migration and a normalized-value-plus-issues result, with explicit decisions about silently corrected inputs and character/byte bounds. Port defaults as data and apply them through component-specific adapters; keep validation independent of terminal execution.

entries.title: Appearance profile files, partial merge and legacy profile migration
entries.source: Profile library/merge: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:16-215`; partial validation: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:221-312`; legacy migration: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-migrate.ts:74-117`. Tests: `ice:packages/coding-agent/test/appearance-profiles.test.ts:34-64`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/test/appearance-profiles.test.ts:84-118`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/test/appearance-profiles.test.ts:126-192`.
entries.what: Saves named appearance presets, duplicates or renames them, and merges selected sections into the current appearance without resetting unrelated sections.
entries.mechanism:
Profiles are JSON files in the global agent directory's appearance-profiles subdirectory. The library validates destination names, writes a temporary sibling then renames it, and exposes partial-profile application separately from filesystem operations.

Names must be nonempty/nonblank, <=64 JS code units, and match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$. listProfiles lists lowercase .json filenames, strips suffix, sorts, and returns[] for absent directory or any error. readProfile parses JSON, requires record and string name, migrates version1 or accepts version2; it does not fully validate contents or require internal name to match filename. Read/delete/source-name operations do not themselves run destination-name validation (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:30-47`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:104-132`).

saveProfile migrates v1, rejects collisions unless overwrite, checks truthy appearance with validateAppearancePartial, and validates themeSetting shape while deferring installed-name availability. It creates the directory, writes JSON.stringify(...,null,2)+'\n' to <name>.json.tmp, then renameSync to destination. No unique temp suffix, lock or fsync is present; failure returns {success:false,error} and may leave a temp or already-written destination. Rename saves new name before unlinking old; duplicate saves a copied profile. Delete reports not found. A partial rename failure can leave both files (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:134-202`).

mergeAppearancePartial clones the base, ignores the patch version and undefined values, recursively merges object/object pairs, replaces arrays or other values wholesale, and returns validateAppearance(merged).appearance without its issues. applyProfileToAppearance rejects a present non-record appearance, then delegates merge. V1 migration retains partial scope, preserves name/description, maps legacy theme string to fixed mode (including opaque slash strings), accepts a supplied typed mode discriminator, changes appearance.version to2 and fills missing rule.caseSensitive=true (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:49-72`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:204-215`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-migrate.ts:80-117`).

Partial validation rejects non-record patches and malformed present object sections using paths derived from defaults, excluding color objects; it explicitly checks border enums for user/assistant/input/code/quote/bash/system and tableStyle. It then merges onto defaults and validates the already-normalized result. Because merge discarded first-pass issues, many invalid colors/formats/rules and chrome/subagent border enums can normalize before this second check; the helper is not equivalent to validating the original partial strictly. Tests cover malformed object sections and several explicit enums, not every discarded issue (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:221-312`).
entries.interfaces: AppearanceProfileV2={version:2,name:string,description?:string,themeSetting?:AppearanceThemeSetting,appearance?:DeepPartial<AppearanceSettingsV2>&{version:2}}. Arrays in DeepPartial replace wholesale. entries.what: Saves named appearance presets, duplicates or renames them, and merges selected sections into the current appearance without resetting unrelated sections.
entries.mechanism:
Profiles are JSON files in the global agent directory's appearance-profiles subdirectory. The library validates destination names, writes a temporary sibling then renames it, and exposes partial-profile application separately from filesystem operations.

Names must be nonempty/nonblank, <=64 JS code units, and match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$. listProfiles lists lowercase .json filenames, strips suffix, sorts, and returns[] for absent directory or any error. readProfile parses JSON, requires record and string name, migrates version1 or accepts version2; it does not fully validate contents or require internal name to match filename. Read/delete/source-name operations do not themselves run destination-name validation (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:30-47`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:104-132`).

saveProfile migrates v1, rejects collisions unless overwrite, checks truthy appearance with validateAppearancePartial, and validates themeSetting shape while deferring installed-name availability. No unique temp suffix, lock or fsync is present; failure returns {success:false,error} and may leave a temp or already-written destination. Rename saves new name before unlinking old; duplicate saves a copied profile. Delete reports not found. mergeAppearancePartial clones the base, ignores the patch version and undefined values, recursively merges object/object pairs, replaces arrays or other values wholesale, and returns validateAppearance(merged).appearance without its issues. applyProfileToAppearance rejects a present non-record appearance, then delegates merge. entries.mechanism:
importBundle accepts a JSON string no larger than256*1024 UTF-8 bytes and versions1/2 only. It returns a normalized v2 data object or an error; actual library staging and settings changes are handled separately by the customizer.

V1 accepts a single embedded theme object, validates it with the JSON theme schema and a label derived from trimmed themeName or imported-theme, accepts a record appearance partial after changing its version to2, and uses a trimmed themeName as fixed selection only when no truthy embedded theme exists. Name/description/author are copied only when strings. Present non-record v1 appearance is silently omitted. entries.what: Stores user-selected layout, decoration, text styling and animation separately from the color palette, and loads older appearance preferences with deterministic defaults.
entries.mechanism:
Validation produces a complete v2 appearance object together with path-specific issues. Missing sections receive defaults, malformed scalar values often normalize silently, and explicit format, color, enum or structural errors make valid=false while still returning a normalized object.

validateAppearance(undefined) succeeds with defaults; a non-record or version other than 1/2 fails and returns defaults. Version 1 migrates then validates. Migration overlays legacy userMessage/inputBox and thinking label/block, copies the legacy thinking indicator into both thinking.indicator and statusIndicators.working, preserves tableStyle, and adds caseSensitive:true to well-shaped legacy literal rules; malformed entries remain available for diagnostics. New v2 sections retain stock defaults (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-migrate.ts:16-71`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:419-463`).

General normalization uses floor and clamp for finite numeric values, fallback for other types; styles filter to allowed names and deduplicate in original order without issues; booleans accept only actual booleans. PaddingX is 0..8 and paddingY 0..4. Indicator interval is 16..5000 ms; at most the first 128 supplied frames are considered, each nonempty and <=64 UTF-8 bytes; invalid entries are skipped and an empty result is an issue. Thinking verbs consider the first 256 entries, trim/deduplicate, require nonempty strings <=128 UTF-8 bytes; empty result is an issue. The two format fields allow <=512 UTF-8 bytes and exactly one {message}/{verb}; other placeholders matching {letter[letters,digits,_,-]*} fail. These format/frame/verb checks do not reject all control characters. Hidden thinking label permits empty and <=128 UTF-8 bytes, otherwise silently defaults. Invalid selection values silently become cycle (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:46-158`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:237-337`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:465-620`).

Color objects distinguish theme/custom/terminal-index/terminal-default/none. Theme token length is 1..128 JS code units and must belong to the foreground or background token set for its role. Custom values <=128 code units must be #RGB/#RRGGBB, rgb(integer 0..255,...) or hsl(hue 0..360,saturation/lightness 0..100%). Eight-digit alpha hex is rejected. Terminal index must be an integer 0..255. None is accepted for explicitly transparent background fields, not foreground/border roles or most TextPresentation backgrounds. Unknown kinds/tokens return the field default plus an issue (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:163-235`).

Footer order filters known IDs, removes duplicates, then appends omitted default IDs; visibility is normalized independently. Separator allows <=32 UTF-8 bytes and rejects C0/DEL. Heading override h1..h6 is normalized only for truthy supplied values, using the default heading base rather than the supplied shared base. Every object section is read through isRecord fallback; the main validator does not diagnose every malformed section shape. Literal rule validation examines the first 65 items, records an issue if supplied length>64, defaults missing IDs to rule-<index>, consumes IDs before matcher validation, requires literal pattern length1..128 code units, truncates display name to64, defaults enabled/caseSensitive unless exactly false, clamps priority0..1000 with original index fallback. A failed validation may therefore return 65 normalized rules, but callers must honor valid=false (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:106-135`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:352-417`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:638-693`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:892-1044`).

entries.source: Complete appearance model and typed theme-setting adapter: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-types.ts:21-388`; defaults: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-defaults.ts:8-208`; migration: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-migrate.ts:16-117`; validator: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:15-1060`. entries.what: Stores user-selected layout, decoration, text styling and animation separately from the color palette, and loads older appearance preferences with deterministic defaults.
entries.mechanism:
Validation produces a complete v2 appearance object together with path-specific issues. Missing sections receive defaults, malformed scalar values often normalize silently, and explicit format, color, enum or structural errors make valid=false while still returning a normalized object.

validateAppearance(undefined) succeeds with defaults; a non-record or version other than 1/2 fails and returns defaults. Version 1 migrates then validates. Migration overlays legacy userMessage/inputBox and thinking label/block, copies the legacy thinking indicator into both thinking.indicator and statusIndicators.working, preserves tableStyle, and adds caseSensitive:true to well-shaped legacy literal rules; malformed entries remain available for diagnostics. New v2 sections retain stock defaults (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-migrate.ts:16-71`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:419-463`).

General normalization uses floor and clamp for finite numeric values, fallback for other types; styles filter to allowed names and deduplicate in original order without issues; booleans accept only actual booleans. PaddingX is 0..8 and paddingY 0..4. Indicator interval is 16..5000 ms; at most the first 128 supplied frames are considered, each nonempty and <=64 UTF-8 bytes; invalid entries are skipped and an empty result is an issue. Thinking verbs consider the first 256 entries, trim/deduplicate, require nonempty strings <=128 UTF-8 bytes; empty result is an issue. The two format fields allow <=512 UTF-8 bytes and exactly one {message}/{verb}; other placeholders matching {letter[letters,digits,_,-]*} fail. These format/frame/verb checks do not reject all control characters. Hidden thinking label permits empty and <=128 UTF-8 bytes, otherwise silently defaults. Invalid selection values silently become cycle (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:46-158`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:237-337`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:465-620`).

Color objects distinguish theme/custom/terminal-index/terminal-default/none. Theme token length is 1..128 JS code units and must belong to the foreground or background token set for its role. Custom values <=128 code units must be #RGB/#RRGGBB, rgb(integer 0..255,...) or hsl(hue 0..360,saturation/lightness 0..100%). Eight-digit alpha hex is rejected. Terminal index must be an integer 0..255. None is accepted for explicitly transparent background fields, not foreground/border roles or most TextPresentation backgrounds. Unknown kinds/tokens return the field default plus an issue (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:163-235`).

Footer order filters known IDs, removes duplicates, then appends omitted default IDs; visibility is normalized independently. Separator allows <=32 UTF-8 bytes and rejects C0/DEL. Heading override h1..h6 is normalized only for truthy supplied values, using the default heading base rather than the supplied shared base. Every object section is read through isRecord fallback; the main validator does not diagnose every malformed section shape. Literal rule validation examines the first 65 items, records an issue if supplied length>64, defaults missing IDs to rule-<index>, consumes IDs before matcher validation, requires literal pattern length1..128 code units, truncates display name to64, defaults enabled/caseSensitive unless exactly false, clamps priority0..1000 with original index fallback. entries.what: Theme selection has a typed fixed/automatic form, while the broader appearance object is global user configuration. Saving a theme through the customizer targets the scope that currently supplies it.

Exactly one slash yields an automatic pair only when both trimmed sides are nonempty; multiple slashes are rejected. Serialization returns the fixed name or light+'/'+dark.

setTheme writes global scope. That call still uses trusted-project checks. getAppearanceSettings validates globalSettings.appearance and returns the normalized appearance even when the stored input is invalid. setAppearanceSettings returns the validation result without writing on invalid input; on success it stores a structured clone and marks appearance. entries.source: Bundle shape: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-types.ts:327-388`; importer/exporter: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:217-496`; theme-setting validation: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:74-102`. entries.what: Imports or exports a portable JSON bundle containing appearance sections, palettes and named profiles without applying or writing anything during parsing.
entries.mechanism:
importBundle accepts a JSON string no larger than256*1024 UTF-8 bytes and versions1/2 only. It returns a normalized v2 data object or an error; actual library staging and settings changes are handled separately by the customizer.

V1 accepts a single embedded theme object, validates it with the JSON theme schema and a label derived from trimmed themeName or imported-theme, accepts a record appearance partial after changing its version to2, and uses a trimmed themeName as fixed selection only when no truthy embedded theme exists. Name/description/author are copied only when strings. Present non-record v1 appearance is silently omitted. This path does not run the full appearance v1 migration, so its behavior is not the same as validateAppearance(version1) copying the working indicator (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:326-383`).

V2 themes must be an array<=64, each schema-parsed; profiles array<=256, each checked for nonempty name length<=64 and version1/2. V1 profile items migrate immediately; v2 profile items validate present appearance but do not validate every profile metadata/themeSetting field here. Top-level appearance uses partial validation, inheriting its normalization limitations. Unknown top-level fields are discarded. Imported theme schemas are checked but full runtime variable resolution occurs later when draft themes are created (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-profiles.ts:385-462`).

Tests: `ice:packages/coding-agent/test/appearance-validate.test.ts:6-124`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/test/appearance-acceptance.test.ts:200-220`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/test/appearance-acceptance.test.ts:310-378`.
entries.what: Stores user-selected layout, decoration, text styling and animation separately from the color palette, and loads older appearance preferences with deterministic defaults.
entries.mechanism:
Validation produces a complete v2 appearance object together with path-specific issues. Missing sections receive defaults, malformed scalar values often normalize silently, and explicit format, color, enum or structural errors make valid=false while still returning a normalized object.

validateAppearance(undefined) succeeds with defaults; a non-record or version other than 1/2 fails and returns defaults. Version 1 migrates then validates. Migration overlays legacy userMessage/inputBox and thinking label/block, copies the legacy thinking indicator into both thinking.indicator and statusIndicators.working, preserves tableStyle, and adds caseSensitive:true to well-shaped legacy literal rules; malformed entries remain available for diagnostics. New v2 sections retain stock defaults (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-migrate.ts:16-71`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:419-463`).

General normalization uses floor and clamp for finite numeric values, fallback for other types; styles filter to allowed names and deduplicate in original order without issues; booleans accept only actual booleans. PaddingX is 0..8 and paddingY 0..4. Indicator interval is 16..5000 ms; at most the first 128 supplied frames are considered, each nonempty and <=64 UTF-8 bytes; invalid entries are skipped and an empty result is an issue. Thinking verbs consider the first 256 entries, trim/deduplicate, require nonempty strings <=128 UTF-8 bytes; empty result is an issue. The two format fields allow <=512 UTF-8 bytes and exactly one {message}/{verb}; other placeholders matching {letter[letters,digits,_,-]*} fail. These format/frame/verb checks do not reject all control characters. Hidden thinking label permits empty and <=128 UTF-8 bytes, otherwise silently defaults. Invalid selection values silently become cycle (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:46-158`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:237-337`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:465-620`).

Color objects distinguish theme/custom/terminal-index/terminal-default/none. Theme token length is 1..128 JS code units and must belong to the foreground or background token set for its role. Custom values <=128 code units must be #RGB/#RRGGBB, rgb(integer 0..255,...) or hsl(hue 0..360,saturation/lightness 0..100%). Eight-digit alpha hex is rejected. Terminal index must be an integer 0..255. None is accepted for explicitly transparent background fields, not foreground/border roles or most TextPresentation backgrounds. Unknown kinds/tokens return the field default plus an issue (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:163-235`).

Footer order filters known IDs, removes duplicates, then appends omitted default IDs; visibility is normalized independently. Separator allows <=32 UTF-8 bytes and rejects C0/DEL. Heading override h1..h6 is normalized only for truthy supplied values, using the default heading base rather than the supplied shared base. Every object section is read through isRecord fallback; the main validator does not diagnose every malformed section shape. Literal rule validation examines the first 65 items, records an issue if supplied length>64, defaults missing IDs to rule-<index>, consumes IDs before matcher validation, requires literal pattern length1..128 code units, truncates display name to64, defaults enabled/caseSensitive unless exactly false, clamps priority0..1000 with original index fallback. A failed validation may therefore return 65 normalized rules, but callers must honor valid=false (`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:106-135`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:352-417`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:638-693`, `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/appearance/appearance-validate.ts:892-1044`).
entries.interfaces:
AppearanceSettingsV2 has version:2 and userMessage, assistantMessage, inputBox, thinking:{indicator,label,block}, statusIndicators:{working,retry,compaction,branchSummary}, markdown, tools, bash, diff, systemCards, footer, chrome, subagentChrome, inputHighlighters. The exact nested field types are declared in appearance-types.ts:52-287. TextPresentation={foreground:AppearanceColor,background:AppearanceColor,styles:AppearanceTextStyle[]}. Styles: bold|italic|underline|strikethrough|inverse. Border styles: none|single|double|round|bold|single-double|double-single|classic|top-bottom-single|top-bottom-double|top-bottom-bold; input border supports only first five. Table style: unicode|ascii|clean|clean-top-bottom|raw. Footer IDs: cwd,branch,session,usage,cache,cost,context,provider,model,thinking,extensions. Theme setting (verbatim): `{ mode: "fixed"; theme: string } | { mode: "automatic"; light: string; dark: string }`; parser accepts a nonempty fixed raw string without trimming, or exactly one slash with trimmed nonempty members; serializer returns theme or light/dark. Validation result: {valid:boolean,appearance:AppearanceSettingsV2,issues:{path:string,message:string}[]}.

Exact defaults are in appearance-defaults.ts:45-208: user {message}, no styles/border, semantic user colors, padding1/0, fit=false; assistant padding0/0/default background/no border; input single border with border token both states,pad0. Thinking frames ⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏,80ms,no reverse,accent; verbs Thinking/Reasoning/Considering/Working/Analyzing/Planning,cycle,{verb}...; visible thinking,Thinking... hidden label,italic/thinkingText. Status spinner colors accent/warning/muted/muted. Markdown unicode and no-override text, no borders/padding; code/quote border semantic tokens. Tools padding1/1,bold toolTitle,toolOutput,state backgrounds. Bash top-bottom-single,bashMode,pad1,bold command/muted output+status. Diff semantic added/removed/context. System cards no border,borderMuted,customMessageBg,padding1/1,custom label/text. Footer all fields visible in declared order,separator ' • ',dim primary/secondary; chrome no border,theme text/selectedBg,muted description,dim hint,default track/scrollbarThumb; subagent states accent/muted/error/warning/dim. No input highlighters by default.
entries.dependency_text: SET-017 owns global appearance settings storage/access and precedence; this entry owns the actual versioned model, defaults and normalizers.
entries.rust: No appearance document, migration, profile or customizer implementation was found by a crates-wide case-insensitive Rust search for appearance/customize/theme_profile/theme_bundle. Independently read native Theme has palette, spacing and border fields but no versioned per-domain appearance model (`rust:crates/ice-tui/src/theme.rs:15-171`, `rust:crates/ice-tui/src/theme.rs:264-386`). Native user rendering exposes one output_pad and a surface background (`rust:crates/ice-tui/src/user_message.rs:41-75`); native assistant options contain hide_thinking, hidden_thinking_label and output_pad (`rust:crates/ice-tui/src/assistant_message.rs:41-59`). These existing capabilities are a starting point, not the stored v2 contract.
entries.port: Add a serde-backed appearance module to ice-tui and global storage adapters to ice-cli through SET-017. Preserve separate palette and layout state. Implement migration and a normalized-value-plus-issues result, with explicit decisions about silently corrected inputs and character/byte bounds. Port defaults as data and apply them through component-specific adapters; keep validation independent of terminal execution.
entries.priority_reason: Required for migrating existing custom layouts and for all appearance editing and rendering features.
